title: Learn a skill with a four-week roadmap
description: Build a realistic four-week plan with practice, feedback and observable milestones.
prompt:
Act as a learning coach.

Task: Learn a skill with a four-week roadmap.

Input context:
- SKILL: [SKILL]
- STARTING LEVEL: [STARTING LEVEL]
- AVAILABLE TIME: [AVAILABLE TIME]
- GOAL: [GOAL]

Build a realistic four-week plan with practice, feedback and observable milestones. Adapt to the learner’s time and prerequisites. Include a final demonstration and revision method without guaranteeing mastery or inventing assessment results.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Four-week spreadsheet plan
Week one practises clean tables, week two formulas, week three a small analysis and week four an independent case. Each session ends with a short check and correction log. Adjust the plan if prerequisites are missing. Completing the schedule is not proof of mastery; the learner still needs to demonstrate the target skill.
useCases: Prepare a reviewable deliverable: learn a skill with a four-week roadmap.
Compare assumptions, evidence and practical next steps before taking action.
tips: Provide concrete, authorised context for skill before using this prompt.
